keywords: The Appellant appealed against the District Court judgement dismissing the Appellant’s ejectment and damages action; whether the premises in suit run as a boarding house was a business premises exempted in terms of Regulation 3 of the Schedule to the Rent Act. Held - Balance of probabilities in favour of the Appellant. Appeal allowed with costs.
